text:
hana: Cascade (FinanceCo) confirmed POC next week. They need SSO (SAML/Okta), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mappings, and domain locking. Who can call out gaps + ETA for any custom work?

samir_sales: FYI they also want a fixed quote for the POC + a follow-on for custom mapping days. Can we separate product support vs eng effort?

mike_se: I can own SE side. Short summary: SAML SP-init + IdP metadata works OOTB. SCIM 2.0 supported for users + groups, but we don't yet support arbitrary attribute->role transforms without a small integration (3 business days). Group->role mapping is supported via admin mappings.

viv_sec: Quick security note: domain proofing options are TXT DNS or admin email. For enterprise customers TXT is preferred. Need Cascade's DNS TTLs and who owns the zone. Also will need SCIM audit logs retention requirement.

mike_se: Example SCIM mapping we typically recommend (very small snippet):
```
scimMappings: {
  "groupSource": "memberOf",
  "roleDestination": "redwood_roles"
}
```
To support attribute-based RBAC (e.g., Okta attribute `dept` -> `rbac_scope`) we add a transform step — estimate 3 days of SE/eng.

samir_sales: Pricing Q: does the 3 days count as Professional Services or is it part of Dedicated/Private onboarding? Customer expects an itemized quote.

hana: Also need answers for their security questionnaire: data residency, KMS options, SCIM log retention, and whether tokens are scoped. I can compile once we have bullet answers.

viv_sec: Draft bullets: data residency: hosted across us-west / eu-west; Private deployment available for strict residency. KMS: BYOK available on Private; hosted supports KMS integration for most cloud KMS. SCIM logs: default 30d, enterprise retention 90d+. Tokens: SCIM tokens scoped to tenant and can be rotated. I'll draft more precise wording.

oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC may affect SCIM syncs for hosted clusters. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/SCIM-maint-2026-04-02

mike_se: Proposed next steps & checklist (I'll drop doc): 1) Verify DNS TXT ownership for protected domains; 2) Provide IdP metadata (xml) + SCIM service token; 3) Provide sample groups and desired role mapping; 4) Confirm retention & residency requirements; 5) Confirm if they want automatic tenant claim blocking or manual review. ETA for checklist doc: EOD today.

samir_sales: Cascade asked: can domain locking block new tenant claims for verified domains? Short: yes — we support tenant claims restriction for verified domains; behavior differs if they want redirect vs email-only verification. We'll need legal if they want forceful takedown policies.

hana: Great — once @mike_se drops the checklist I’ll prepare the quote and attach the security questionnaire answers. Send any blockers here.

mike_se: Dropped draft checklist: https://redwood.ai/internal/presales/cascade-scim-saml-checklist (internal). :point_up:

samir_sales: :thumbsup:
